get.summary: One market-intelligence record, for the Ask citation side panel.
get.description: R-EVD-02 / requirements.md §6 API table: 'one market record (for the citation panel)'; parent story us-01-market-intelligence AC-5: 'returns one record with its provenance label and updatedAt for the citation panel'. No X-Tenant-Id: the market index is shared and read-only for every tenant (ADR-024 'three sources, one rule'), the same 'no authorization boundary to enforce' reasoning GET /api/capabilities above shares. Task E13/F06/US01/T01 (ask-engine) is this route's first writer (backend/src/Raffa.Api/MarketEndpointExtensions.cs); as of this task's own commit that file does not compile (two competing method bodies concatenated mid-statement -- a dangling `if` referencing an out-of-scope `endpoints` variable, a duplicate `deal` local, ~11 duplicate anonymous-object property names), which breaks the whole Raffa.Api assembly, and no Raffa.Api.Tests file exists for this route either. Rather than block this web task on a backend defect outside its own 'Files to create or modify' (backend/**), this operation is authored directly from the task's own coding-objective field list ('title, category, geography, band, provenance label, updatedAt') plus the real, clean, unbroken domain types it is built from: Raffa.Market.Contracts.MarketDeal (record shape), Raffa.Market.Retrieval.MarketNoteComposer.Compose (title/category/geography/provenance/updatedAt -- BuildTitle: '{Supplier} · {Product}'), Raffa.Market.Contracts.MarketProvenance.Label ('representative market data · mock feed · updated yyyy-MM-dd'). `band` is this task's own addition, not named on MarketNote -- the three real percentile prices (MarketDeal.UnitPriceP25/P50/P75) plus Currency, structured rather than left as the citation card's own prose snippet (which already exists separately on the citation, ReplyCitation.Snippet). Once F02/T02's persisted `market_record` store and a fixed MarketEndpointExtensions.cs land, whichever lands last should diff its real response against this document rather than assume a silent match (the same rule this document's own info.description already states for Documents V2).

200.description: The record.

provenance.description: MarketProvenance.Label(deal), e.g. 'representative market data · mock feed · updated 2026-09-01'.

Documented here for contract completeness, the same 'repeating chore' as GET /api/insights/criticality above -- task E13/F09/US01/T04 (web-ask-v2) does not add a client.ts wrapper: AskCopilotService composes this pack internally for the Ask reply's own 'renewal strategy' narration; no screen in this task's own coding objective renders it standalone. `whenYouMustMove`/`targets` dates and amounts are frequently null (no renewal/cancellation date yet, or no benchmark match -- StrategyInputs.SupplierName is always null today per that type's own doc comment, so no priced-line target ever resolves a real benchmark), an honest 'insufficient market data'/'not yet available' outcome per R-STR-01 AC-3, never a fabricated number.

get.summary: The tenant's audit trail, newest first -- Admin only.
get.description: Maps to GetAuditEventsAsync in backend/src/Raffa.Api/AuditEndpointExtensions.cs, backed by Raffa.Audit.Infrastructure.AuditQueryService (task E01/F06/US02/T02; wave w16 NW-08, task E18/F02/US02/T01, ADR-025 §K). Same ICallerContext -> WorkspaceRoleResolver ladder every other tenant-scoped route in this document uses (DocumentsEndpointExtensions' reprocessDocument/deleteDocument handlers): missing/non-GUID X-Tenant-Id -> 400; a well-formed tenant with no live workspace_membership -> 404, never 403 (ADR-025 Rule B1 -- a 403 there would be a tenant-existence oracle); a live member who is not Admin -> 403; a live Admin membership -> 200. The claims-based guard this route used before wave w16 (WorkspacePrincipalAuthorization, a tenant_id claim plus a ClaimTypes.Role claim -- unreachable by any real client, since nothing in this host ever minted either) is deleted whole (ADR-025 §K.2). Bare array response, newest first, capped at AuditQueryService.MaxResults (200) -- no caller-supplied paging or filters yet. No client.ts wrapper: this route has no caller in this web epic, so it joins the documented-but-unwrapped set GET /api/insights/criticality and GET /api/contracts/{id}/strategy already establish (ADR-012 w16 footer clauses 24, 27) -- the generated schema.ts type is what OQ-w16-003's ruling ('no web audit surface') is satisfied by.

parameters.description: Authorized selector, verified against the caller's own workspace_membership before any row is read -- never an authorization input by itself (ADR-026 w16 clause 2).

get.summary: Tenant-wide quote history, each quote carrying its own market-benchmark position.
get.description: Maps to GetBenchmarkHistoryAsync in backend/src/Raffa.Api/QuotesEndpointExtensions.cs (task E25/F04/US01/T01, quote-benchmark-backend AC-2; ADR-028 -- history is server state; closes NW-57). The tenant's quotes, newest first, each carrying a freshly-recomputed per-line market-benchmark assessment -- the identical per-line shape getQuoteAssessment returns (status/position/benchmark/confidence/targetSaving/explanation), reused rather than duplicated. A first-of-type quote (no fixture comparable exists yet for its supplier/product) reports the honest InsufficientBenchmarkData cold start on its own lines, never a fabricated position (ADR-001). Nothing new is persisted: every row here is read fresh from the same Quote/QuoteLine tables GET /api/quotes already lists -- see backend/src/Raffa.Quotes/Application/QuoteBenchmarkHistoryService.cs's own doc comment for why 'history' means durable server state, not a snapshot frozen at upload time. Never 404s: a tenant with no quotes yet gets 200 with an empty items array. Same interim X-Tenant-Id header placeholder as every other operation in this document.

200.description: The tenant's quotes, newest first, each with its own per-line market-benchmark assessment. Empty items when the tenant has no quotes yet.

lines.description: Same per-line shape getQuoteAssessment's own 'lines' array returns -- see this operation's own description for why 'position' is not declared with 'enum' here (web/scripts/generate-api-client.mjs#renderSchemaType drops a nullable union's null member whenever the schema also declares enum).
